name: mcp-server-scaffold
title_zh: 十分钟搭好一个能跑通的最小 MCP 服务器
tagline_zh: 别从空目录开始啃 MCP SDK 文档。它给你 TypeScript 或 Python 二选一，自带一个工具。
tagline_en: Skip the blank-directory grind. Pick TS or Python, get one tool, stdio transport, and a smoke test—then wire it.
desc_en: Scaffold a minimal MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in TypeScript or Python with one tool, local stdio transport, and a smoke test. Use when the user wants to create an MCP server, add a tool for Claude Code or Cursor, connect an agent to a local script or API, or mentions MCP SDK, mcp.json, or Model Context Protocol.
why_zh: 它把 MCP 的骨架焊死成最小可运行单元，不塞多余样板。你改的是工具逻辑，不是协议胶水。
why_en: It welds the MCP skeleton into a minimal runnable unit—no boilerplate bloat. You edit tool logic, not protocol glue.
limit_zh: 只生成单工具、stdio 传输的本地服务器，不含流式、鉴权、远程部署或多工具编排。产物到能跑通冒烟测试为止，UI。
limit_en: Single-tool, stdio-only local server. No streaming, auth, remote deploy, or multi-tool orchestration. Ends at passing smoke test—UI, logging, error.
title_en: Scaffold a minimal MCP server in 10 minutes
